decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the three additional required articles; their placement remains owned by the source Requirement.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records that the table of contents must be completed after content and pagination are finalized.
The existing attribution rule already applies to every article, so adding three articles does not change its state.
Consistency with the cover concerns content inclusion, not a change to the magazine's visual-style or color rules.
Adding and placing the cover-referenced articles does not change the existing rule for requesting supplemental images.
The source decision changes issue content and ordering but does not alter the digital PDF deliverable.
The source does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
No launch-date or deadline change is stated or logically required by the content addition.
The source adds articles but does not change their text-and-visual pacing treatment.
The source does not affect hosting cost, candidate platforms, or platform branding.
